2607.26515.title: HiFloat4 Format for End-To-End Reinforcement Learning Post-Training of Large Language Models
2607.26515.paper_summary: We present, to our knowledge, the first end-to-end FP4 RL post-training, in which both the rollout and training policies, including their forward and backward passes, operate at 4-bit precision. A systematic study reveals that the dominant source of degradation in FP4 RL is not training-side quantization error but rollout activation quantization: outliers stretch the dynamic range so far that a large number of activation values underflow to zero under FP4. Counterintuitively, restoring the training policy to higher precision while keeping the rollout in FP4 makes accuracy worse than full FP4 baseline, exposing rollout-training mismatch as the principal failure mode and ruling out standard pretraining-style fixes. We address this with Rollout Residual Quantization (Rollout-ResQ): a single residual correction term constrained to a hardware-friendly sparsity pattern, added only to the FP4 rollout matmul -- a lightweight correction that recovers most of the precision lost to outlier-driven underflow without inflating the rollout's compute footprint. On Qwen2.5-3B and Qwen2.5-Math-7B, Rollout-ResQ paired with the HiFloat4 (HiF4) format -- whose three-level hierarchical scaling preserves resolution under FP4's tight 4-bit budget -- closes the accuracy gap to BF16 from 4.9% to 1.1%, bringing fully quantized FP4 RL within striking distance of full precision. Applied to the open-standard MXFP4, the same recipe narrows the gap from 13.6% to 5.3%, revealing that FP4 format choice is a key factor that determines the ceiling on recoverable accuracy. Together, these results establish HiF4 as the enabling format for end-to-end FP4 RL post-training, and Rollout-ResQ as the activation-side mechanism that makes the gap to BF16 closable.
2607.26515.paper_summary_zh: 我們提出了目前所知的首個端到端的 FP4 RL 後訓練，其中滾動和訓練策略，包括它們的前向和後向傳播，均以 4 位精度運行。系統研究顯示，FP4 RL 中主要的降級來源不是訓練端的量化誤差，而是滾動激活的量化：異常值將動態範圍拉伸到如此程度，以至於大量激活值在 FP4 下下溢至零。反直覺的是，將訓練策略恢復到更高精度的同時保持滾動在 FP4 中，使準確性比完整的 FP4 基線更差，暴露了滾動與訓練的不匹配作為主要失敗模式，並排除了標準的預訓練風格修正。我們通過滾動殘差量化（Rollout Residual Quantization，Rollout-ResQ）來解決這個問題：一個單一的殘差修正項，受限於硬體友好的稀疏模式，僅添加到 FP4 滾動的矩陣乘法中——這是一個輕量級的修正，恢復了大部分因異常值驅動的下溢而損失的精度，而不會膨脹滾動的計算足跡。在 Qwen2.5-3B 和 Qwen2.5-Math-7B 上，Rollout-ResQ 與 HiFloat4（HiF4）格式配對——其三層層次縮放在 FP4 的緊湊 4 位預算下保持了分辨率——將準確性差距從 4.9% 縮小到 1.1%，使完全量化的 FP4 RL 逼近全精度。應用於開放標準 MXFP4，使用相同的方法將差距從 13.6% 縮小到 5.3%，顯示 FP4 格式選擇是決定可恢復準確性上限的關鍵因素。綜合這些結果，確立了 HiF4 作為端到端 FP4 RL 後訓練的啟用格式，而 Rollout-ResQ 則作為使與 BF16 差距可縮小的激活端機制。
